## From tango and vineyards to the Perito Moreno Glacier and Iguazú Falls

This 12-day itinerary leaves time to see the highlights of each region without rushing. You have a free day in Buenos Aires for an optional trip to Tigre, a ranch for a Fiesta Gaucha, or Montevideo via La Plata.

Buenos Aires gives the trip a cultural start. Mendoza feels different after the capital, with less of the big-city bustle, more open space, vineyards and the Andes close by. El Calafate takes you into the chill of Patagonia, while Iguazú rounds out the trip with heat, dense greenery and the constant sound of falling water. The contrast is part of what makes this route distinctive.
